entry_points.text: User surface spans per-cgroup pool files and per-tier read-only nodelist snapshotting union masks under lock; NUMA group created under memory object with single attr, discarding object on attach failure.
Late boot holds online-memory protection and tier mutex while assigning every untyped memory node ignoring per-node failures, then single rebuild.
Early boot option sets default online type; weak empty hook allows platform reporting after populate without default effect.

exports.text: Tiering predicates gate access-time tracking and top-tier classification on balancing mode, NUMA presence, tier assignment and start distance against a global threshold.
Type descriptors carry distance, membership and refcount with find-or-create, release and bulk unlink; node binding takes a ref only on first map and releases at zero.
Abstract distance delegates to a per-node notifier chain; default DRAM perf records first reporter and rejects deviants, then scales base distance by latency and inverse bandwidth.

Public surface offers demotion toggle, allowed/pluggable range queries, default online-type access, hotplug bracketing, range/section add, map populate/verify, failure report and early reserve; toggle write on disabled-to-enabled resets hopeless counters.

Zone/node span helpers clear, evaluate, expand, shrink, recompute and relocate coverage; vmemmap level helpers create missing tables on demand and range helper populates page by page, failing on first unmapped address.

hazards.text: Tier lookup fails invalid when linked type misses quantized tier, no-memory on alloc failure, propagates device errors after unlink; distance helpers reject zero totals, missing reference and prior mismatch distinctly.

Invalid hot-add, out-of-range, altmap mismatch and misalignment warn and fail cleanly; oversize/collision fail distinctly; verify warns once on remote backing; failure reports rate-limited, skipped for quiet or unmanaged DMA, with relaxed node filtering for victims/privileged/non-task/non-reclaim contexts.

invariants.text: Compressed pool exposes flushed usage, atomic max accepting number or maximum keyword, and writeback accepting only zero/one; current and max hidden on root; swap init warns but succeeds.

Tiers quantize distance to chunk start, reuse equal start else insert sorted with device id from start; assignment validates memory, refreshes distance with DRAM fallback and publishes tier; rebuild scans only next lower tier keeping equidistant minima and builds fallback by sweeping and stripping higher tiers.

Memmap-on-memory defaults disabled with enable/forced variants; block cost scales with frames times descriptor size with forced pageblock rounding; online policy defaults contiguous with auto-movable alternative, ratio 301, NUMA aware, movable nodes off, default type unresolved, boot ceiling at max.

Registration checks pluggability and boot ceiling then claims global pool, flagging nonstandard names driver-managed with distinct oversize/collision errors; release is null-safe; sparse add requires subsection granularity.

Subsection masks mark inclusive index intervals; fill rejects empty or overlapping, clear rejects missing usage or mismatch; section setup validates encoding, stores base and sets presence; index uses slab when ready else early reserve, fatal on boot failure; one build reuses roots, other always succeeds.

Empty occupancy clears map presence and frees usage unless boot-reserved, depopulating ordinary or freeing early storage; footprint counters take signed deltas; size estimate varies by optimization/order/alignment; tail sharing needs unaligned offset spanning subsections; edge shrink steps subsections collapsing to empty.

Contiguity affirms only when every block window resolves to same zone with cooperative yields; node extent spans lowest start to highest end; relocation clears contiguity, expands spans, taints split device edges and inits descriptors; removal poisons in section pieces bypassing shrink for device zones.

Missing intermediate tables allocate zeroed pages and link parents; present leaves preserved, new leaves use fresh or caller frame with extra ref for shared tails and kernel attrs in init space; altmap rejects non-page multiples, aligns by size, never reports negative free.

locks.text: Tier mutex serializes creation, assignment, rebuilds, type-map updates and mask reads; helpers assert caller already holds it.
DRAM reference guarded by own mutex; per-node tier pointer published via RCU, read under RCU and cleared with grace before storage recycle; rebuild blanks state with grace.
Online-page callback guarded by dedicated mutex with generic initial handler; install allows only generic-to-custom once and restore only back to generic, both under online-memory reference.

state_machines.text: Node exit clears published pointer, waits readers, removes type membership unlinking empty types, destroys tier device when member list empties; unregister triggers async release freeing storage.

Boot registers bus, allocates demotion storage when migration enabled, creates default DRAM type, records DRAM CPU nodes and subscribes hotplug; removal clears tier and rebuilds, addition assigns and rebuilds; rebuild no-ops without storage or migration, else blanks, repopulates threshold/masks and logs.
Placement parser accepts forced keywords case-insensitively else boolean with one-time waste notice, renderer distinguishes forced; policy parser resolves via string table rejecting unknowns.

Add validates then loops section extents, first failure wins; section add prepares, activates, scrubs and marks present; activation reuses early partials else populates with rollback; population selects compound/generic, flushes on success; address build goes top-down then verifies; backing prefers altmap else slab else early reserve.

Occupancy bitmap plus presence/present/online/taint markers drive lifecycle; onlining marks whole sections; ranged onlining chunks by maximal alignment, debugs, invokes callback per chunk; bulk removal validates alignment then processes section pieces cooperatively.

structs.text: Tier object holds global-order and member lists, distance-window start, embedded device and lower-tier node aggregate; per-node demotion is one preferred mask; per-node type pairs descriptor pointer with mapping count.

NUMA sysfs is null-terminated single-toggle collection in a group under memory object plus bus/devices with per-tier nodelist; placement/mode ops bind custom parsers/renderers; names cover pool files, numa group, demotion toggle, force variants, Y/N and policy strings; codes and tunables use fixed initial values; negative status signals failure.
